LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HitchGizmoDesc: Choose a trailer standing within {CELLS} cells. A colonist walks over and couples it, and it is set straight behind this vehicle. The trailer and all it carries then add to the weight the engine must pull.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CancelGizmoDesc: Stop waiting for {TRAILER} to be coupled.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_UnhitchGizmoDesc: Let {TRAILER} go where it stands. It stays there, loaded, until a vehicle hitches it again.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NotOurs: {TRAILER} is not ours. Claim it first.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_DrawbarBroken: The drawbar of {TRAILER} is broken: there is nothing to couple to until it is repaired.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_TooFar: {TRAILER} is too far away. Park within {CELLS} cells of it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NoRoom: There is no room behind {TRACTOR} for {TRAILER}. Clear the ground behind it, or park somewhere more open.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CannotFollow: The trailer cannot follow: {TRAILER} would run into something, so {TRACTOR} has stopped. Take a wider way round, or unhitch it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_LeftBehind: {TRAILER} stays behind: it could not be taken along on the journey.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NoRoomToSetDown: There is no room near {TRACTOR} to set {TRAILER} down. It stays on the tow bar; clear some ground or move {TRACTOR}.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SetDownFailed: {TRAILER} could not be set down and is still on the tow bar. Move to open ground and it will be set down there.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HeldGear: Held to gear {GEAR} by the engine's power.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HeldPower: Held back by the engine's power.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HeldGrip: Held back: the wheels cannot grip.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CrawlPower: Crawling: the engine has not the power for it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookFull: On this ground {TRACTOR} can pull {TRAILER} at full speed ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookSlowed: On this ground {TRACTOR} would be slowed by {REASON} with {TRAILER} behind ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookCrawls: On this ground {TRACTOR} could only crawl with {TRAILER} behind, for want of {REASON} ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookTooHeavy: {TRAILER} is too heavy for {TRACTOR} to tow ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_InspectPlainCap: Held to {CAP} of its speed by the weight behind it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_InspectDrawbarBroken: Its drawbar is broken: it cannot be towed until it is repaired.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SettingOthers: Vehicles without the drivetrain model can tow
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SettingOthersDesc: Off by default: only vehicles whose engine, gears and grip the drivetrain model works out can tow, and for them a heavy trailer slows the climb, runs the engine hotter and burns more fuel. On, every other land vehicle can tow too, but on a plain rule only: it keeps its own weight's share of its speed, whatever its engine, the ground or the hill. A small car pulling a loaded trailer will crawl; a big truck barely notices.
